Action if Subway is flooded to the brim: • Operate reserve pumps and submersible pumps to control water level in the subway.
• Put heavy duty pumps to suck out water.
• Keep sufficient lorries, JCBs, dozers and men for removal of silt, garbage and floating materials etc., in the subway once rain stops.
